website_summary.name: Health Tracker Dashboard
website_summary.description: The website presents a clean and organized interface for tracking food intake, exercise, and progress toward health and fitness goals.
website_summary.appearance: The website features a minimalist design with a light gray background and white card containers for different sections. At the top, there's a navigation bar with options such as "Set Weight Goal" and "Export Data." Below this, users can select time frames ("Today," "This Week," "This Month," "Custom") and tabs for "Food," "Exercise," "Weight," and "Progress." The main content area includes sections like "Add Food," which allows users to input nutritional data, and "Food Log," displaying logged food entries. There are also visual representations like charts for "Macro Nutrients" and "Calories Overview," providing insights into dietary patterns.
website_summary.functionality: The website enables users to log their food consumption by entering details like carbs, protein, fat, fiber, and calories. Users can view their food logs within selected timeframes. Additionally, it offers functionalities for setting weight goals, exporting data, and tracking progress through various metrics. Charts and graphs help visualize macro nutrient distribution and calorie intake/expenditure.
